newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA TO FACE BETIS IN SPANISH CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA TO FACE BETIS IN SPANISH CUP FINAL.

text.p: Barcelona completed the formality of ensuring a place in the Spanish Cup final against Real Betis on Thursday.
Barcelona beat second division Las Palmas 3-0 in the home second leg of their semifinal, Oscar Garica, Luis Enrique Martinez and Fernando Couto getting the goals to wrap up a 7-0 aggregate rout.
Betis reached their first final for 20 years on Wednesday when they ousted Celta Vigo 2-1 on aggregate.
The final is in Madrid on June 28 after the league season ends.
